info:
In collaboration with graphic designer Isabelle Virnot, we decided to portray an MMA discipline, grappling, through our eyes.	A sport that is very much violent in its nature, yet it portrays itself to be sensual and intimate. 
 This project was made at ECAL under the supervision of Nicolas Polli and Anouk Agabekov-Schneider.

Inspired by the movie franchise Dunes, I decided to recreate a sci-fi narration around the need to be constantly connected to a computing source. 
 This project was made at ECAL under the supervision of Charlotte Krieger.
